elements.label: Background actor turning and walking away
elements.change_other: live-action actor turns her back and walks off camera-left, ending behind the foreground actor

pattern.description: Filmed live-action office scene: a locked-off camera holds on a seated employee while a colleague in the background turns and walks away after a line of dialogue. The motion is actor blocking, not graphics.
pattern.why_premium: Shallow depth of field, a static locked-off frame and in-frame actor blocking sell a relatable workplace story before the product appears; the ending reaction beat on the seated actor carries the comedic timing.

build_hint.gsap: Not a motion-graphics build: place the filmed clip as a <video> layer on the HyperFrames timeline (no tween on the clip itself); if a graphic must follow, start it with gsap.fromTo(overlay, {opacity:0, y:20}, {opacity:1, y:0, duration:0.5, ease:'power2.out'}) after the actor exits frame.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> inside a <Sequence> for the live-action clip with no interpolation; any follow-on overlay can enter with spring({fps, frame, config:{damping:200}}) driving opacity and translateY.

notes: Live-action footage with camera.move none; the diff boxes do not isolate the moving actor, so a manual box was used. The foreground actor makes only small head movements, not listed. No SFX candidates; the stem shows only music tones.
